2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information __on a display device associated with the subscriber's receiving equipment__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein filtering comprises: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber __based on subscription tier or service package information__; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein obtaining comprises: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider __via a secure communication channel__; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information __that is maintained locally on a client device__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein removing comprises: reading the EPG information __received from the EPG provider__; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers __and storing the filtered EPG information separately from the original EPG information__.

6. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the programs are delivered by one of a television network, a cable operator, a direct satellite program provider, a digital cable content provider, and a network content provider.

7. (Currently amended) An article of manufacture comprising: a machine-accessible medium including data that, when accessed by a machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving electronic program guide (EPG) information from an EPG provider __at a client device__; and filtering the EPG information __at the client device__ to retain program information related to programs delivered by a content delivery provider to a subscriber, the content delivery provider being different from the EPG provider, __wherein the filtering occurs after the EPG information is retrieved and stored locally on the client device__.

8. (Currently amended) The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data further comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information __on a display device associated with the client device__.

9. (Currently amended) The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data causing the machine to perform filtering comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber __based on subscription tier or service package information__; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber.

10. (Currently amended) The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform obtaining comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider __via a secure communication channel__; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information __that is maintained locally on the client device__.

11. (Currently amended) The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform removing comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: reading the EPG information __received from the EPG provider__; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers __and storing the filtered EPG information separately from the original EPG information__.

14. (Currently amended) The program guide module of claim 13 wherein the enhanced EPG module further comprises: a module to display the filtered EPG information __on a display device associated with the subscriber's receiving equipment__.
